ctx.x: Well, we were -- we had gone to bed in this hotel, and our agent, government agent came around and knocked on the door and said, 'We're leaving. They've assassinated our President.' So tomorrow, the next day we got together and left. No, it was that next day or two days, couple of days (unintelligible). But one thing, the whole country seemed to close up in commemoration of the President; they really observed that incident.
How much longer did the tour have to run?
